test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

I’ve got __a lot of homeworks__ this weekend.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**a lot of homework**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Homeworks**" is not a correct usage of the word; it should be "**homework**".
 
• The word "**homework**" is generally considered an uncountable noun, and it **does not usually take a plural form**.
 
• When referring to a large amount of homework, it is more appropriate to use "**a lot of homework**" rather than "**a lot of homeworks.**"
 
• The use of "**a lot of homework**" maintains proper grammar and accurately conveys the idea of having a significant amount of schoolwork to complete over the weekend.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.
